limits.standard_limit: 600 API calls per connection per 60 seconds; 1000 MB transferred per connection per 60 seconds; SharePoint Online list view threshold 5000 items

m2_usage_estimate.calls_per_operation: 2-6 for writes/read summaries depending on Get items/Create item/Update item branches
m2_usage_estimate.basis: 12 PMO operations, expected pilot production volume around 50 user operations/day, with SharePoint used by all legacy PMO_PA flows and most PM0 targets

limits.mitigation: Keep list queries indexed and filtered by ProjectID/Deleted; avoid broad unfiltered Get items once lists approach 5000 items.

limits.standard_limit: 100 API calls per connection per 60 seconds; Flow bot / adaptive-card non-GET operations 25 requests per connection per 300 seconds

m2_usage_estimate.calls_per_operation: 1-3 Teams posts/updates for confirm, result, and channel broadcast
m2_usage_estimate.basis: Hybrid card-first routes are mostly DM plus selected channel broadcasts

limits.mitigation: Keep card sends sequential per flow and avoid retry storms; channel broadcasts only on ADR-defined operations.

limits.standard_limit: 100 API calls per connection per 60 seconds; trigger poll frequency 1 per 360 seconds; basic plans only

m2_usage_estimate.basis: Planner is used by CriarTarefa, AtualizarTarefa, and ListarTarefas PM0 targets

limits.mitigation: Use existing locked plan/bucket IDs; maintain sequential Planner update branches and persist PlannerSyncStatus/PlannerSyncError in SharePoint.

limits.connector: Power Virtual Agents / Copilot Studio Standard
limits.standard_limit: PVA connector API calls per connection 100 per 60 seconds; Copilot Studio flow calls count as Power Platform requests

m2_usage_estimate.calls_per_operation: 1 action/flow call from topic after confirmation or read request
m2_usage_estimate.basis: 12 user-facing topics invoke one action each in the M2 target state

limits.mitigation: Preserve one final action call per topic; avoid multi-action topic fanout.

limits.standard_limit: Office 365 / Microsoft 365 seeded users: 6000 Power Platform requests per user per 24 hours official; transition period shows 10000 per cloud flow; five-minute ceiling 100000 requests

m2_usage_estimate.calls_per_operation: 10-30 Power Automate actions depending on branch and card/result handling
m2_usage_estimate.basis: 50 operations/day at 30 actions worst-case during pilot

limits.mitigation: Monitor Power Platform request reports after publish; if volume grows, split high-use flows or consider Process licensing before strict enforcement.

overall_assessment.reason: Expected pilot volume is far below documented connector-per-minute and Power Platform per-day limits. The main operational risk is not quota exhaustion; it is retry amplification if card posts or SharePoint/Planner writes fail.
